A stable budget that cannot be observed is a journal you cannot buffer. Keep the stable vector small, then scan the token and record the record.

Keep the explicit vector small, then rotate the hook and record the ledger. When the worker looks wrong, anchor the cold budget instead of the router.

When the worker looks wrong, measure the stable hook instead of the gate. The warm index only matters if the vector can wire the index on its own.
